an10.171:1.1: Adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo anattho ca,
an10.171:1.3: adhammañ ca viditvā anatthañ ca, dhammañ ca viditvā atthañ ca, yathā dhammo yathā attho, tathā paṭipajjitabbaṃ.
an10.171:2.1: Katamo ca bhikkhave adhammo ca anattho ca? 2.
an10.171:2.2: Pāṇātipāto adinnādānaṃ kāmesu micchācāro musāvādo pisunā vācā pharusā vācā samphappalāpo abhijjhā vyāpādo micchādiṭṭhi.
an10.171:2.3: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave adhammo ca anattho ca.
an10.171:3.1: Katamo ca bhikkhave dhammo ca attho ca? 3.
an10.171:3.2: Pāṇātipātā veramaṇī adinnādānā veramaṇī kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇī musāvādā veramaṇī pisunāya vācāya veramaṇī pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī samphappalāpā veramaṇī anabhijjhā avyāpādo sammādiṭṭhi.
an10.171:3.3: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave dhammo ca attho ca.
an10.171:4.1: Adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo anattho ca,
an10.171:4.3: adhammañ ca viditvā anatthañ ca, dhammañ ca viditvā atthañ ca, yathā dhammo yathā attho, tathā paṭipajjitabban ti
an10.171:4.4: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ, idaṃ etaṃ paṭicca vuttan
